dct_description_sm: Guinea administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 8 Region - Admin 2: 34 Prefecture - Admin 3: 340 Sub-prefecture Dates associated with this dataset: - 24 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 04 March 2016: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 03 August 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 03 August 2017: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rowca). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
